description: Content library for the Biblia Tafsiri Mbalimbali agent. RULE (owner-set, 2026-09-22): the caption language MUST match the language of the scripture on the image — English image -> English caption, Swahili image -> Swahili caption ("lang" field on every entry). The agent alternates daily: one day English, the next Kiswahili. 100 images = 55 English (YouVersion Verse of the Day graphics + verse cards composed on AI backgrounds with NIV text fetched from bible.com) + 45 Kiswahili (YouVersion "Fungu la Siku" graphics + verse cards with SUV text fetched from bible.com). Captions: verse + two sentences of explanation and encouragement + five hashtags ending with #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali. With the GEMINI_API_KEY secret configured, Google Gemini rewrites the Swahili encouragement sentences at posting time (stored caption = fallback). Rotation: each language pool cycles in order; ~100 days of unique content before any image repeats.
